snippet.title: The Specification Surface Is the New Source of Truth | A Visual Deep Research Dive
snippet.description:
A 39-minute visual deep research dive on why specification surfaces become the governed source-of-truth artifact in AI-assisted software work.

The central claim: generated code is only reviewable when the controlling intent lives in durable, maintained, validated, and trace-linked surfaces that teams can inspect and repair.

Original essay: https://lambpetros.substack.com/p/the-specification-surface-is-the
TL;DR explainer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FM3ex8zl-PY

Rooted Layers Visual Deep Research Dives:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL8lPx5mgRhhbABS4A238_OjCy_6xEUCBd
